title: lygodium expansum
intro: Lygodium expansum, commonly known as the climbing fern or climbing water fern, is a species of fern in the family Lygodiaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestion. Lygodium expansum is believed to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to protect against various diseases. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
